blurb: `advance Clock by …` moves the harness clock, which only a `case` owns. A `property` runs its body once per generated input and has no clock of its own, and non-test code reads real time. Put the time-dependent step in a `case`. `bynk.test.advance_not_clock` and `bynk.test.advance_not_duration` cover the other ways to get `advance` wrong.
summary: An `advance Clock by` statement appears outside a test `case` body; only the test harness has a clock to move.
